title: The Washing Away of Wrongs
synopsis: Song Ci, who lived more than 700 years ago during the Southern Song dynasty, is widely recognized as the world’s first forensic entomologist. He recorded his experiences and observations in “The Washing Away of Wrongs“, also known as “Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified“.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
《洗冤集录》——破解死亡密码的宝典

    200多年前的中国清朝，一名女子在家中上吊自杀。官员查验现场后，翻开一本流传了数百年的办案宝典，然后断定女子是他杀，不是自杀。因为办案宝典中记载，如果死者是上吊自杀，颈后部的索痕不会相交，舌头会伸出。但女子颈后部索痕相交，舌头没有伸出，这是被勒死的特征。官员审讯了女子的丈夫，丈夫承认勒死妻子并伪造了自杀现场。
    上面这个故事里，官员手中那本记录详细的办案宝典名叫《洗冤集录》。它是中国历史上第一部系统的法医学著作，也是中外学者公认的世界上最早和最系统的法医学专著。这部书的作者是宋朝一名长期从事刑狱断案工作的提刑官，名叫宋慈。提刑官相当于现在的最高级法官。这部书是宋慈总结宋代及以前法医学经验，加上自己的工作心得，创作而成的法医宝典。
    宋慈出生于福建的一个书香世家，从小接受正统的儒家教育。32岁通过科举考试获得官职，但在上任前父亲去世，他回乡为父守孝。39岁正式步入官场，在广东、江西、福建、湖南等地做过官，四次担任提刑。62岁写成《洗冤集录》，两年后病逝。《洗冤集录》首刊于1247年，被当时的皇帝指定为政府刑狱官员的必读书目。全书共分为五卷，主要内容包括验伤、验尸、辨伤、检骨、急救等，并对相关程序及方法做了详细论述。其中法医检验的部分内容，符合现代科学原理。1438年，这部书传入韩国；1736年又被翻译成日文。此后陆续传入欧美，译本多达20余种。
    鉴于《洗冤集录》对世界法医学的贡献，宋慈被公认为世界法医学奠基人。他一生清廉爱民，执法严明。特别重视现场勘验，讲求证据，断案严肃慎重。他在《洗冤集录》的序言中写道，这部书可以“洗冤泽物，当与起死回生同一功用”，意思是书中记录的方法可以为冤死的人洗清冤屈，这和医生治病救人、起死回生的功用是一样的。
    700多年过去了，宋慈和他的《洗冤集录》依然在闪耀光辉。2005年一部以宋慈为原型拍摄的电视剧《大宋提刑官》受到观众的强烈好评，直到今天依然占据悬疑剧评分榜的高位，是公认的古装悬疑经典之作。如果你对《洗冤集录》和宋慈感兴趣，不妨从观看这部电视剧开始，走进一个真实而生动的宋朝。
fullText.traditional:
《洗冤集錄》——破解死亡密碼的寶典

    200多年前的中國清朝，一名女子在家中上吊自殺。官員查驗現場後，翻開一本流傳了數百年的辦案寶典，然後斷定女子是他殺，不是自殺。因為辦案寶典中記載，如果死者是上吊自殺，頸後部的索痕不會相交，舌頭會伸出。但女子頸後部索痕相交，舌頭沒有伸出，這是被勒死的特徵。官員審訊了女子的丈夫，丈夫承認勒死妻子並偽造了自殺現場。
    上面這個故事裡，官員手中那本記錄詳細的辦案寶典名叫《洗冤集錄》。它是中國歷史上第一部系統的法醫學著作，也是中外學者公認的世界上最早和最系統的法醫學專著。這部書的作者是宋朝一名長期從事刑獄斷案工作的提刑官，名叫宋慈。提刑官相當於現在的最高級法官。這部書是宋慈總結宋代及以前法醫學經驗，加上自己的工作心得，創作而成的法醫寶典。
    宋慈出生於福建的一個書香世家，從小接受正統的儒家教育。32歲通過科舉考試獲得官職，但在上任前父親去世，他回鄉為父守孝。39歲正式步入官場，在廣東、江西、福建、湖南等地做過官，四次擔任提刑。62歲寫成《洗冤集錄》，兩年後病逝。《洗冤集錄》首刊於1247年，被當時的皇帝指定為政府刑獄官員的必讀書目。全書共分為五卷，主要內容包括驗傷、驗屍、辨傷、檢骨、急救等，並對相關程序及方法做了詳細論述。其中法醫檢驗的部分內容，符合現代科學原理。1438年，這部書傳入韓國；1736年又被翻譯成日文。此後陸續傳入歐美，譯本多達20餘種。
    鑒於《洗冤集錄》對世界法醫學的貢獻，宋慈被公認為世界法醫學奠基人。他一生清廉愛民，執法嚴明。特別重視現場勘驗，講求證據，斷案嚴肅慎重。他在《洗冤集錄》的序言中寫道，這部書可以“洗冤澤物，當與起死回生同一功用”，意思是書中記錄的方法可以為冤死的人洗清冤屈，這和醫生治病救人、起死回生的功用是一樣的。
    700多年過去了，宋慈和他的《洗冤集錄》依然在閃耀光輝。2005年一部以宋慈為原型拍攝的電視劇《大宋提刑官》受到觀眾的強烈好評，直到今天依然佔據懸疑劇評分榜的高位，是公認的古裝懸疑經典之作。如果你對《洗冤集錄》和宋慈感興趣，不妨從觀看這部電視劇開始，走進一個真實而生動的宋朝。

sentence_translations: “The Washing Away of Wrongs”: A Guide for Decoding the Mysteries of Death
Over 200 years ago, in the Qing dynasty of China, a woman hanged herself at home.
After inspecting the scene, the official opened a case-handling manual that had been passed down for hundreds of years ..
.. and concluded that the woman had been murdered rather than having taken her own life.
According to the case-handling manual, if the deceased committed suicide by hanging, ..
.. the rope marks on the back of the neck would not intersect, and the tongue would protrude.
However, the woman had intersecting rope marks on the back of her neck, and her tongue was not protruding.
These were characteristics of strangulation.
Officials interrogated the woman’s husband, who admitted to strangling his wife and staging the scene as a suicide.
In the story above, the detailed case-handling manual in the official’s hand is called “The Washing Away of Wrongs”.
It was the first systematic work on forensic science in Chinese history.
It is also recognized by scholars both in China and abroad as the world’s earliest and most systematic treatise on forensic science.
The author was a Song dynasty judicial commissioner who spent many years investigating and adjudicating criminal cases.
His name was Song Ci.
A judicial commissioner was equivalent to a supreme court judge today.
In the book, Song Ci summarized forensic experience from the Song dynasty and earlier ..
.. and combined it with his own insights to create a forensic science compendium.
Song Ci was born into a scholarly family in Fujian and received a traditional Confucian education from an early age.
At the age of thirty-two, he passed the imperial examination and obtained an official position.
However, before taking office, his father passed away, and so he returned to his hometown to observe the mourning period for his father.
At the age of thirty-nine, he officially entered government service.
He held positions in Guangdong, Jiangxi, Fujian, and Hunan, serving as a judicial commissioner four times.
He completed “The Washing Away of Wrongs” at the age of sixty-two and passed away from illness two years later.
“The Washing Away of Wrongs” was first published in 1247.
It was designated by the emperor of the time as mandatory reading for government judicial officials.
The book is divided into five volumes.
The main content includes wound examination, autopsy, wound identification, bone examination, and first aid.
It also discusses related procedures and methods in detail.
Some aspects of the content on forensic examination conform to modern scientific principles.
In 1438, the book was introduced to Korea, and in 1736, it was translated into Japanese.
It was later introduced to Europe and America, with more than twenty translations produced over time.
In recognition of the contributions of “The Washing Away of Wrongs” to global forensic science, ..
.. Song Ci is widely acknowledged as the founder of forensic science.
Throughout his life, he was honest and incorruptible, devoted to the people, and strict in enforcing the law.
He placed particular emphasis on crime scene inspections, valued evidence, and handled cases with seriousness and caution.
In the preface to “The Washing Away of Wrongs”, he wrote that the book could ..
.. “redress injustices and benefit the people, serving the same function as curing disease and reviving the dying.”
This means the methods recorded in the book could clear the names of those wrongly condemned to death, ..
.. just as physicians, through healing, can save lives and bring the dead back to life.
More than 700 years have passed, yet Song Ci and his “The Washing Away of Wrongs” still shine brightly.
A 2005 TV series based on Song Ci, “Judicial Commissioner of the Great Song”, received widespread acclaim from audiences.
To this day, it continues to rank high on mystery drama rating charts and is widely regarded as a classic in the historical suspense genre.
If you are interested in “The Washing Away of Wrongs” and Song Ci, ..
.. you can start by watching this TV series and walking into a real and vivid Song dynasty world.
